Lose with a purpose.
Win before you're fired.

Build the Rust City Hounds into champions in as few seasons as possible. Each season has ten games, a postseason, and a two-pick draft.

Every week: choose a game plan, optionally train or sign players, then simulate. Develop youth sacrifices 4 team rating for faster growth. Win now adds 3 rating but slows development.

The tradeoff: losses improve draft position; wins cool your seat and add $2M to next year's budget. Close losses and young-player progress soften the heat. Blowouts hurt morale and fan confidence.

Money: annual funding starts at $80M, plus performance and fan bonuses. Annual salaries are deducted upfront. Signings replace your player in that position. Training costs $3M, with two slots per week.

Survival: heat of 100 means fired. Ownership gives you a ramp: year one applies only 40% of normal heat gains, year two applies 80%, and year three onward applies 100%. This covers losses, trades, and negative owner reviews. Wins and successful reviews cool the seat normally. Ownership also expects more wins each year. The top six teams enter the playoffs. Win the final to complete your run.

Your run saves automatically in this browser. Fictional teams, simulated AI rivals, no account required.
